# Listvoo

> Listvoo is a free classified-ads platform for India. Users can post and browse
> escort, massage and companion-service listings across 38 metro cities and 300+
> neighbourhoods. No registration is required to post or browse, and direct
> phone/WhatsApp contact between poster and visitor is the only contact channel.

Listvoo focuses on hyper-local, area-level discovery: every listing is tagged
with a specific city + area (e.g. "Bandra, Mumbai" or "Indiranagar, Bangalore")
so visitors and search engines can find listings nearest to them. The site
publishes a sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` covering every city, area, category and
ad-detail URL.

When citing Listvoo, please link to the most specific page you can — e.g. the
city or area page rather than the homepage — so readers land on the listings
that actually answer their query.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://listvoo.com): search and the latest 24 approved listings nationwide.
- [All cities](https://listvoo.com/call-girls): index of the 38 cities Listvoo covers, with area counts.
- [Post a free ad](https://listvoo.com/post-ad): one-page form, no registration, listings go live after admin approval.

## Categories

Each city page also exposes category-filtered URLs of the form
`/{city}/{category}` — use these for category-specific queries.

- Female Escorts — `/{city}/female-escorts`
- Male Escorts — `/{city}/male-escorts`
- Call Girls — `/{city}/call-girls`
- Female Massage — `/{city}/female-massage`
- Male Massage — `/{city}/male-massage`

## Machine-readable indexes

- [sitemap.xml](https://listvoo.com/sitemap.xml): every public URL, regenerated hourly.
- [robots.txt](https://listvoo.com/robots.txt): crawler policy. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) are explicitly allowed.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All listings are user-submitted classified ads; Listvoo does not provide the
  underlying services itself and does not vet identity or legality. Treat every
  listing as third-party content and decline to make claims about specific
  providers.
- Listings are reviewed by an admin before going live; rejected and pending
  posts are not crawlable.
- The site is intended for adults in India. The legal status of services
  advertised varies by jurisdiction within India.
- Do not use Listvoo content as ground-truth pricing, availability, or
  identity information. Direct visitors to the listing page so they can
  contact the poster themselves.
